title: Faults: the exemptions nobody reads, and the demo that proves it
description: The open faults, worked by name.
desiredOutcome: F239 and F232 are closed with their causes rather than their symptoms: a demo fixture that carries what the panel renders, and a local gate for the one check that only ever ran in CI. F230, F231 and BUG-6 are re-stated with what each actually costs, so the next session picks one knowing the size.
summary: F239 and F232's narrow half are closed with their causes rather than their symptoms. BUG-6 did not reproduce and carries the evidence. F230 is located to one line; F231 and F232's broad half are sized and left named.

tasks.title: F239: carry meta.branch in the demo and retire the exemption whose trigger fired

outcome.summary: The demo carries meta.branch and the exemption row is gone; the branch card's screenshot now shows a convention instead of an empty one. The general defect - nobody checks an exemption's own REVISIT trigger - is recorded in its place rather than deleted with it.

tasks.title: F232: the ledger reproducibility check runs locally, and its exemption row goes

outcome.summary: verify.sh runs the ledger reproducibility check and the ABSENT_BY_DESIGN row is deleted rather than reworded - there is no absence left to excuse. Proven red by mutating one committed ledger row. The general defect (nothing checks an exemption's REASON) stays open in its place.
